summary: Iteration 9: Verified new Client Dashboard summary cards (Officer Check-ins Today, Active Post Sites, Payslip Summary 7 days) and extended /api/portal/summary. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass including 2 new tests asserting exact scoped values (checkins_today=1, active_post_sites=1, payslip_7d.total=80.0, shifts=1, officers=1) and Globex non-leak isolation. Frontend: acme@client.com login lands on /client, all 3 new StatCards render with the expected data-testids and values (৳80.00 with subtext '1 shifts · 1 officers'). Existing cards (Total/Upcoming Schedules, Completed Shifts, Vendors, Officers, Post Sites) still render. Admin login unaffected; admin still 403 on /portal/*, client still 403 on /dispatch/*.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_summary(): uses COMPLETED_STATUSES for checkins_today which aligns with 'Clocked In' + 'Clocked Out' per problem statement. Good.
payslip 7-day window uses Dhaka-local dates (dhaka_today - 6 days .. today inclusive) — 7 calendar days, correct.
SPECIAL_OFFICERS ({'TEMP','OPEN_SHIFT'}) excluded from officer count in payslip — good defensive handling.
to_list(10000) hard cap on week schedules — acceptable for weekly window; document if a single client is ever expected to exceed 10k shifts/week.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (Acme officer clocked-in today 8h@rate10 => 80; 1 active + 1 inactive Acme post sites; Globex officer @rate99 + Globex active post site).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests added: test_portal_summary_new_cards_scoped_to_acme and test_portal_summary_isolation_globex_not_leaking. Frontend data-testids for new cards: stat-officer-check-ins-today, stat-active-post-sites, stat-payslip-summary-7-days. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_client_portal.py -v -o addopts=
